This project is a java 21 Maven-based Java binding for GTK using JNA.
It supports both GTK 3 and GTK 4 versions (detecting and loading the correct shared libraries at runtime).
It provides a simple and intuitive API for interacting with GTK widgets and components.
Prioritize performance, memory efficiency, and stability

Ignore APIs to create widgets/components as UI will be defined via glade.
Focus on interactions with widgets/components and handling signals

Don't create unit tests for this project.
Ingnore examples for now. Creates a final example app when project is ready.
